tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance as per Section XII.

Item-by-item commentary on the Purchaser's Technical Specifications demonstrating substantial responsiveness of the goods and services to those specifications or a statement of deviations and exceptions to the provisions of the Technical Specifications.

As on date of Notification of Bid, the Bidder shall not be under any declaration of ineligibility for unsatisfactory past performance, corrupt or fraudulent practices, any other unethical business practices or blacklisted either by Government of India or State Governments or any public-sector units of State and Central Governments

The Bidder should be a registered company in India as per the Indian Companies Act 1956/ 2013 or Partnership firm as per Partnership Act 1932 or Proprietary Concern and is in the business for the last 3 years (i.e., year, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) as on 31.03.2026

The Bidders should have supplied and Installed 182 number of Desktops/ Printers/ UPS/ Laptops/ Interactive Panels in one of the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 to any of the State Government or Central Government departments or State/ Central Public Sector Units or Private Institutions
The tenderer should furnish details of Service Centres and information on service support facilities that would be provided after the warranty period (in the Service Support Form given in Section XV)
The bidder/OEM should have valid ISO 9001-2015 and IS0 27000-2013 certificate as on bid submission date.

The Bidder should have executed similar project/s (Supply and Installation of Desktops / UPS / Printers) of value not less than Rs. 3.76 crore in one of the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 to any of the State Government or Central Government departments or State/ Central Public Sector Units or Private Institutions

The Bidder should be in the business of supply and installation of Computer Hardware during last 3 financial years (i.e., year 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) as on 31.03.2026 and should have the experience in supply & maintenance of recent series Computer models (2025 onwards).

The Bidder should have executed similar project/s (Supply and Installation of Desktops / UPS / Printers) of value not less than Rs. 3.76 crore in one of the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 to any of the State Government or Central Government departments or State/ Central Public Sector Units or Private Institutions
The Bidder should have a consolidated minimum positive Net Worth as on the last day of each of the preceding 3 financial years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26).
The Bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of 4.75 crore, during last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26
The Bidder and OEM should mandatorily satisfy all conditions mentioned in Karnataka Government Order No: FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru Dated 25/8/2020
